links.outcome: AUC of original versus locally recalibrated IMPACT-score on local cohort
links.effect: Local recalibration improved AUC from 0.642 (original IMPACT-score) to 0.719 (IMPACT-score-Necker); original AUC was 0.752 in NCDR-IMPACT validation cohort.
links.quote: Local calibration of the IMPACT-score on our cohort enhanced predictive accuracy, improving the AUC from 0.642 to 0.719, and addressing differences between our population and the original NCDR-IMPACT cohort.

links.outcome: Original model performance on local historical data versus original validation cohort
links.effect: Original IMPACT-score achieved AUC 0.642 in the local hospital cohort versus 0.752 in the NCDR-IMPACT validation cohort.
links.quote: When applied to our hospital cohort, the IMPACT-score-Necker achieved an AUC of 0.719 whereas the original IMPACT-score achieved an AUC of 0.642.
